recommendation: Keep the no-change audit commit. If future work wants specific historical Binary conversion maps to emit securityContext messages, handle that separately in conversion-registry or historical transform scope rather than changing current core mapping-language source for FHIR-17032.
issue_request: FHIR-17032 was a Published/Persuasive with Modification FHIR-I STU3 change request asking for the mapping language to explicitly declare unknown or lost source content, motivated by Binary.securityContext in historical version maps. The approved resolution was to add a log "xxx" as part of the source statement and make the make/target part optional when a log part exists.
initial_application: Jira records application as svn revision 14038. Git commit d9c2be4be8e21f4a6e2020aafe5e631cb691b0f4 (`GF#17032 - add logging to mapping language`) added the original Log Statement documentation to source/mapping-language.html, and that commit is an ancestor of the current branch.
additional_context: StructureMap is active in source/fhir.ini and mapping-language.html is in the Implementation Support hierarchy. The old Binary version-map page cited by Jira is not present as current build source; the durable current-spec requirement is the language/StructureMap capability. FHIR-17710 later requested examples for the same log feature and is already represented on the combined branch. FHIR-20841 parenthesized embedded FHIRPath expressions, and FHIR-39486 kept the mapping-language `log` keyword while documenting equivalence to FHIRPath trace().
reconciliation: Published an empty audit commit. Current mapping-language.html documents log as part of source statements, explains evaluation order, includes literal and FHIRPath examples, and states that rules may have no target transform. The active StructureMap definition has source.logMessage and target min=0, and images/mapping.g4 allows ruleSources with optional ruleTargets plus source log syntax.

related_jiras.note: Requested clearer examples for the log statement introduced by FHIR-17032; it is already represented on the combined branch.
Required embedded mapping-language FHIRPath expressions, including log expressions, to be parenthesized.
Declined renaming mapping-language log to trace and added trace-equivalence documentation.
